comment: A detached session's launch flags survive a resume that omits them: each launch records its --copilot-arg values and --driver per CodeSpace and session, and a launch that names only the session (--copilot-arg=--resume=<id>, like a supervisor's wake after a CodeSpace stop) reuses them instead of falling back to the host's defaults. Anything passed explicitly replaces the record; the JSON reports what was recalled.
